# Approved Manuscript

This folder holds locked, approved versions of each chapter and the final full manuscript.

**Do not edit files here without deliberate intention.** These are your source-of-truth versions.

## Contents

- Individual approved chapter files (`ch01_approved.docx`, etc.)
- Full compiled manuscript (`WTAF_full-manuscript_vX.docx`)

## File Naming Convention

```
ch01_approved.docx
ch02_approved.docx
WTAF_full-manuscript_v1.docx
WTAF_full-manuscript_v2.docx   ← increment on each major revision pass
```

## Approval Checklist (per chapter)

- [ ] Draft complete and self-edited
- [ ] Beta/CP feedback incorporated
- [ ] Continuity checked against canon
- [ ] Timeline verified
- [ ] Copied here from manuscript/
